settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.text: Fast dispatch, free delivery over $50 and easy returns within 14 days. Here is exactly what happens after you order.

settings.heading: When will my order arrive?
settings.text: Business days, Monday to Friday. You get a tracking link by email as soon as the parcel leaves our warehouse.

settings.label: Days to dispatch
settings.text: Packed by hand in our warehouse

settings.label: Free delivery from
settings.text: On every order over the threshold

settings.label: Days to refund
settings.text: Back to the way you paid

settings.heading: Choose at checkout
settings.text: The exact price for your address shows at checkout before you pay.

settings.title: Write to us
settings.text: Send your order number and what you would like to return — within 14 days of delivery.

settings.title: We arrange the pickup
settings.text: A courier collects the parcel from your door. The pickup is free.

settings.title: We check the parcel
settings.text: Usually on the day it arrives. We let you know by email.

settings.title: Money back
settings.text: Within 3–5 business days, to the card or account you paid with.

settings.question: Can I track my parcel?
settings.answer: Yes — the tracking link comes by email as soon as the parcel leaves our warehouse, and it is also in your account under the order.

settings.question: What if I am not at home?
settings.answer: The courier calls before delivery and can leave the parcel with a neighbour or bring it the next business day.

settings.question: Which products can be returned?
settings.answer: Any product in its original, unopened packaging. Opened cosmetics and supplements cannot be returned for hygiene reasons — unless they arrived damaged.

settings.question: What if a product arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Send us a photo within 48 hours of delivery and we will send a replacement or a refund — no need to return the damaged item.

settings.question: Can I exchange a product?
settings.answer: Yes. Write to us which product you would like instead; we pick up the first one and send the new one in the same trip.

settings.heading: Good to know
settings.text: More answers are on our FAQ page.

settings.heading: We will sort it out within a day
settings.text: Late parcel, wrong product, a question about a return — write to us with your order number and a person from our team will take care of it.
